name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is an 'if' rule — 'If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first' makes reaching the exit a condition, not a commanded goal, so no Existence(at_exit) is wanted. The single hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) states exactly that at_exit may not happen before the first switch_toggled, which is what 'must have flipped the switch first' says; the empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning are valid for this conditional.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, the switch must have been toggled first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
